headline: World Bank Projects Kenya's GDP Growth at 4.6% in 2026 Amid Energy Cost Pressures
summary: The World Bank projects Kenya's economy to grow by 4.6 percent in 2026, while warning of rising energy costs, fiscal pressures, and unpredictable weather.
why: GDP growth forecasts by major international financial institutions help investors gauge macroeconomic health, sovereign risk, and consumer demand in emerging markets.
